verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench with a desktop app, web UI, terminal agent and plugin page APIs, so a versioned-API and deprecation-policy story is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no API versioning scheme, changelog of API changes or documented deprecation policy. The plugin 'page API' mention and the note that new installs keep old Lite data are adjacent at best and do not count as versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
